notes: live/surfaces.test.ts cases are not listed here: loadManifest() derives them directly from public's apps/server/src/auth/route-policy-table.ts, apps/server/test/authz/surfaces.ts and apps/server/src at PUBLIC_PIN (one source), and coverageReport() reports any uncovered or dropped routes without failing pin bumps or CI.

live/surfaces.test.ts runs A's credential at B live only for one smoke per credential kind (SMOKES in src/surfaces.ts: session, PAT, OAuth) and the deny-only cases (real-only and interactive-only routes derived from public); every other case's A at B is the in-server matrix's foreign callers (MATRIX_AT_B), which smokeGaps checks (#1137 group B).

#1235: live/surfaces.test.ts runs A's credential at A only on the session and PAT smokes (SMOKES), as the positive control for their A-at-B leg; every other case runs B's own credential at B, and A_AT_A in src/surfaces.ts names what replaces its A at A. The 17 live cases retired in #1235 are listed with the failure each guarded and their replacements in src/retired.ts, which the fake suite holds to this manifest.

live/provisioning.test.ts no longer runs P35 (a routeless Worker fetches rl-a /healthz): the runner can't stand in for that Worker, so it could only ever be unproven. The gap is #1260; REMOVED_PROBES in src/provisioning.ts records it.

live/provisioning.test.ts no longer runs P50 (the held-sweep snooze owner path on rl-snz): proved live once, and covered by apps/server/test/directory.snooze.test.ts and the authz surface list (apps/server/test/authz/surfaces.ts) (#1078); REMOVED_PROBES in src/provisioning.ts records it.
